description: Approve a review gate. Continuing downstream steps BILLS CREDITS — without confirm:true this only returns what continuing will cost (up to max_credits) and continues nothing. Omit block_ids to continue over ALL blocks the run processed; pass a subset to continue only those; pass [] to close the gate WITHOUT running (or billing) anything further (no confirm needed). No downstream steps → error no_continuation (use run_gate_acknowledge).

block_ids.description: Blocks to continue over: omit for all the run’s blocks, a subset for only those, [] to close the gate without running anything.

confirm.description: true to continue and spend credits; omit to get the price only.

job_id.description: The run whose review gate is pending (gate_pending true in run_get).

name: run_gate_approve
title: Approve review gate (bills credits)
